End User / Analyst Remediation Action: Verify server status in cloud console. Pull localized diagnostic heap dumps, restart the application process with updated memory limits, and request a capacity scale-up if leak persists.

Incident Summary: [Slowdown] Service Performance Degradation on API checkout endpoint
Root Cause Details: Downstream third-party payment gateway experienced network latency spike (TCP handshake delay), bottlenecking local connection pool.
End User / Analyst Remediation Action: Review Dynatrace Service Flow dashboard. Engage the external vendor team to verify their endpoint health, and temporarily toggle circuit-breaker configuration to handle failures gracefully.
